description: update.yml opens formula release PRs and publish.yml supplies their bottles; Renovate updates workflow dependencies.

customManagers.description: Read Homebrew Actions' four-part calendar tags without truncating the version.

packageRules.description: The github-actions manager truncates Homebrew Actions' tags to three parts, a tag that does not exist, so only the custom manager above updates them.
test-bot runs cache and artifact upload on pull requests, so their majors merge once checks pass. Release-only actions and runners require separate validation.
